mapper.select:
SELECT l.sample_no AS sampleNo, l.batch_no AS batchNo, l.material_name AS materialName, l.material_code AS materialCode, l.material_spec AS materialSpec, l.quantity, l.unit_id AS unitId, l.destruction_reason AS destructionReason, l.destruction_method AS destructionMethod, l.destruction_location AS destructionLocation, l.destruction_time AS destructionTime, l.remark, l.destructor_id AS destructorId, l.supervisor_id AS supervisorId FROM lm_retention_destruction_ledger l WHERE 1=1
AND l.material_id IN
#{materialId}
AND l.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
AND l.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sampleNo}, '%')
AND l.destruction_time >= CONCAT(#{destructionStartDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND l.destruction_time <= CONCAT(#{destructionEndDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY l.destruction_time DESC
